title: Full-Stack AI Story Generator
tagline: AI-powered SaaS using OpenAI API to generate personalized children's stories
description: Developed an AI-powered SaaS using the OpenAI API to generate personalized, interactive children's stories based on dynamic user inputs. Built a type-safe backend with Drizzle ORM and Neon PostgreSQL, optimizing data access for a serverless architecture. Implemented secure authentication via Clerk, supporting social logins and managed user sessions.

title: Doctor Appointment Booking System
tagline: Full-stack MERN application with secure authentication and Role-Based Access Control
description: Architected and developed a full-stack MERN application with secure user authentication and Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) for Admin and Patient roles. Implemented RESTful APIs to manage appointments, departments, doctors, and users, ensuring scalable data operations.

title: Full-Stack RecipeHub
tagline: Recipe-sharing MERN platform with JWT authentication and image uploads
description: Built a recipe-sharing MERN platform allowing users to create, update, delete, and explore recipes. Developed a secure RESTful API with JWT authentication, protected routes, password encryption, and image uploads using Multer. Delivered a modern, responsive UI with clean architecture and scalable backend design.

title: AI Chat Bot Application
tagline: AI-powered chat application with real-time responses using Gemini API
description: Developed an AI-powered chat application with real-time conversational responses using the Gemini API. Integrated AI image generation with Fal.ai, along with dark/light mode and responsive UI design. Implemented clean state management using Context API for scalable architecture.

title: Multilingual Food Delivery App
tagline: Food delivery platform supporting English and Arabic with live search and filtering
description: Built a multilingual food delivery platform supporting English and Arabic using i18next. Implemented live search, dynamic category filtering, dark/light mode, and toast notifications. Delivered a fully responsive UI powered by Vite, Redux Toolkit, and modern React architecture.
